Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How significant was new technology as a cause of the stalemate on the Western Front by 1915?
Explain your answer. [40]
How important was the failure of the Ludendorff Offensive as a reason for Germany’s surrender in
1918? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How significant was the weakness of the political leaders of the Weimar Republic in 1932–33 as a
reason for Hitler’s appointment as Chancellor in January 1933? Explain your answer. [40]
How important was the use of the SS in maintaining Nazi control of Germany after 1933? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How significant was Tsar Nicholas II’s decision to take personal control of the military as a cause
of the March Revolution in 1917? Explain your answer. [40]
How important was Lenin’s role in winning the Russian Civil War? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How important were credit and hire purchase as reasons for economic growth in the USA in the
1920s? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was overproduction as a cause of the Wall Street Crash in 1929? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were Mao’s guerrilla tactics as a reason for the Communist victory in the Civil War?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was China’s development of nuclear weapons as a cause of worsening relations
between China and the USSR? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the impact of the Second World War as a reason for the success of the National
Party in 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was internal opposition in the struggle against apartheid up to 1980? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the use of terrorism as a reason for the end of British rule in Palestine by
1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Israel as a cause of the Six-Day War in 1967? Explain your
answer. [40]
